correctness.rationale: For G=Cartesian product of finite paths P_ni with ni>=2, one marked origin singles out every distance layer and the unique farthest corner. Stability exposes predecessor colour multisets. Induction reconstructs each vertex’s multiset A={x_i} using triangular deck relations S0=p a0+a1 and Sj=(p-1)aj+a(j+1) for j>=1; reflection from the farthest corner similarly reconstructs B={L_i-x_i}. Comparing A,B predecessor and successor signed-card changes reconstructs actual coordinatewise pairs (x_i,L_i-x_i), including zero coordinates via upper neighbours. Equality of these pairs is exactly the orbit under permutations of equal-length axes fixing origin. Therefore class count product_m binomial(r_m+m-1,m-1) and multinomial sizes follow for all d>=3, also formally d=1,2; no unstated dependence on disjoint factor lengths. I independently checked that A,B alone need not encode the pairing (the supplied example P2×P3×P4), making the combined card argument necessary.
